_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_granted_escape.py. t_breach is Underworld Breach's static without the end-step sacrifice: every nonland card in your graveyard has escape at its own mana cost plus three other cards. t_locker_grant is The Grim Captain's Locker's grant as a sorcery that exiles itself, so the permission outlives its source and names its own {3}{B}.

cards.name: Test Underworld Breach
cards.oracle_text: Each nonland card in your graveyard has escape. The escape cost is equal to the card's mana cost plus exile three other cards from your graveyard.

abilities.text: Each nonland card in your graveyard has escape. The escape cost is equal to the card's mana cost plus exile three other cards from your graveyard.

cards.name: Test Locker's Grant
cards.oracle_text: Until end of turn, each creature card in your graveyard gains "Escape—{3}{B}, Exile four other cards from your graveyard." Exile Test Locker's Grant.
